Non reentrant for the same Socket Id. Parameters (in) Socket Id Socket identifier of the related local socket resource. Parameter Id Identifier of the parameter to be changed Parameter Value Pointer to memory containing the new parameter value Parameters (inout) None Specification of TCP/IP Stack AUTO SAR CP R20 - 11 83 of 293 Document ID 617 : AUTOSAR_SWS_TcpIp Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ Re turn Type E_ OK: The parameter has been changed successfully. E_ NOT_ OK: The parameter could not be changed. Description By this API service the TCP/ IP stack is requested to change a parameter of a socket. E.g. the Nagle algorithm may be controlled by this API. Available via Tcp Ip.h
